##### Project general facts

Mayyas at The Bay is a contemporary residential development located on Yas Island, designed for those who value an active island lifestyle enriched by entertainment, leisure, and dining experiences. Developed by Advanced Properties, the project introduces a vibrant living environment that blends coastal energy with everyday comfort, offering residents immediate access to the island’s dynamic attractions while maintaining a sense of privacy and ease.

The development spans eight storeys and features a diverse mix of residential formats, including studios, junior apartments, lofts, apartments, duplexes, and townhouses. Thoughtfully planned layouts and private balconies or terraces create spaces suitable for both relaxation and social living. The overall concept emphasizes versatility and lifestyle flexibility, catering to a wide range of residents seeking a refined yet practical home on Yas Island.

Interiors are finished in a light, minimalist style that enhances natural brightness and creates a clean, elegant atmosphere. The focus is on simplicity, neutral tones, and functional design. Kitchens are delivered without appliances, and residences are not furnished, allowing owners the freedom to personalize their homes according to individual taste and lifestyle preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island, situated in Abu Dhabi, is a sprawling leisure and entertainment destination that has garnered global acclaim. This man-made island covers approximately 9.6 square kilometers (3.7 square miles) and offers a wide array of world-class attractions. One of its highlights is the renowned Yas Marina Circuit, which hosts the exhilarating Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, attracting racing enthusiasts from around the world.

At the heart of Yas Island is Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, an indoor theme park dedicated to the legendary Italian sports car manufacturer. This extraordinary park enthralls visitors with its thrilling rides, including the record-breaking Formula Rossa roller coaster that accelerates to speeds of up to 240 kilometers per hour (149 miles per hour). Ferrari World also presents captivating exhibits showcasing the brand's history and heritage.

Beyond its iconic attractions, Yas Island is a vibrant hub of luxury accommodations, restaurants, bars, and clubs. The island's upscale hotels and resorts offer unparalleled comfort and breathtaking views, while its dining and entertainment venues cater to diverse tastes and preferences. With its excellent connectivity and proximity to Abu Dhabi International Airport, Yas Island provides convenient access for both local visitors and international travelers.
